Messages.Author: Sithlord
Messages.Body:
Hello There!

I need a clarification on whether SCS can use for example, burst of
sunlight at the superior level, if Tremere Convocation is in play, since SCS
text dictates that he can be treated as a vampire.

TIA,
Aris Lambrianidis

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <9n915v$69012$1...@ID-67156.news.dfncis.de>, Sithlord
<sith...@hol.gr> writes

> I need a clarification on whether SCS can use for example, burst of
>sunlight at the superior level, if Tremere Convocation is in play, since SCS
>text dictates that he can be treated as a vampire.

No. Tremere Convocation cannot apply since Shadow Court Satyr does not,
in fact, have the discipline. He merely has the option to use the card
at the inferior level (card text).
